body:
How Greg's main TermAl UI is served on Central, checked read-only on 2026-11-03 by Termal::Opus2:
- :4173 is the Vite DEV server (node pid 41336 at the time), running C:\github\Personal\TermAl\ui\node_modules\.bin\..\vite\bin\vite.js from the MASTER checkout's ui/.
- A landed UI change (ff of master in the master checkout) is therefore live immediately through HMR or a page reload. It needs NO TermAl restart.
- The backend on :8787 also serves ui/dist (ServeDir fallback in src/main.rs) as a production build that agents do not rebuild (the launcher never builds production UI).
- A change to ui/package.json dependencies would need `npm install` in the master checkout, which is outside agent authority, so flag it.
- Other Vite processes seen: a preview on :4174 (Sol previews) and a vite.switch-performance config.
